# awseal

> Sign an artifact so a stranger can verify it.

"Download this and run it" is a request for trust with nothing behind it.

## Install

```
pip install awseal
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Sign one release file and hand someone the verify command.

## Composes with

- [awshare](https://aitherium.github.io/awshare/) — Publish an artifact and fetch it back verified.
- [awdit](https://aitherium.github.io/awdit/) — An append-only audit trail whose gaps are DETECTABLE.
- [awrena](https://aitherium.github.io/awrena/) — Put two agents head to head and get a verdict you can check.
- [awrtifact](https://aitherium.github.io/awrtifact/) — Deliberately chunk artifacts into GitHub release assets — the productized aitherkvcache mirror lane.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awseal
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awseal/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/awseal/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awseal.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
